content: {"phoneNote":"The typographic layout is bold and functional, but the first screen repeats the call and directions links three times each and duplicates the seasonal rush notice.","desktopNote":"The asymmetric two-column hero and structured price list work very well, though contact actions and the seasonal warning are needlessly repeated inside the first screen.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":5,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Remove the redundant 'Pokličite nas' link under the hero intro and the duplicate seasonal rush sentence at the bottom of the opening hours block.","On phone, hide the static header action bar since the contact details and links are already immediately visible in the first screen.","Style the CTA links in the gold banner as proper buttons rather than plain underlined text links so they stand out better as a final action."],"blockers":[]}
